About LEXYGO

Zhejiang Changxing Shengli Intelligent Machinery Co., Ltd. develops and supplies practical equipment for moving, lifting, and stacking material loads.

Product focus

Electric pallet trucks, electric pallet stackers, electric forklifts, manual pallet trucks, and warehouse lifting equipment.

Factory location

Manufacturing and project coordination in Changxing, Zhejiang, China.

Commercial approach

Model-level data, application-based selection, configurable projects, and direct export communication.

Brand

LEXYGO is used for the independently marketed material handling product range.
